create.name: Atisha Centre
create.bio:
Atisha Centre is a Tibetan Buddhist retreat and study centre set in native bushland at Myers Flat, about fifteen minutes north-west of central Bendigo in Victoria. It was founded in 1981 and belongs to the FPMT network started by Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, following the teachings of the Dalai Lama in the Mahayana tradition. Its neighbours are the Great Stupa of Universal Compassion and the Thubten Shedrup Ling monastery, and nuns from the nearby Machig Labdron Nunnery also lead some sessions. The resident teacher is Geshe Thubten Rabten, a Sera Jey geshe who once served as master of the monastery's debate ground, teaching through his translator Venerable Lobsang Dorje.

Geshe Rabten gives a weekly evening teaching on Shantideva's guide to the bodhisattva way of life and a fortnightly study weekend on Tsongkhapa's Middle Length Lamrim, both by suggested donation. Guided meditation runs on Sunday mornings at the centre and on Tuesday evenings in the city, there are day courses for beginners, short meditation retreats and occasional pilgrimages to India, and visitors can stay on site in rooms or campsites for their own retreat. Nearly every teaching is filmed, and the centre's YouTube channel holds several hundred recorded sessions free to watch.

courses.title: Setting up a Daily Practice
courses.description: A one-day introductory course with Venerable Jampa Choepal on core Buddhist practices such as taking refuge, the Four Immeasurables, mandala offerings and water bowls, and how to bring them into everyday life. Suitable for curious beginners and as a refresher; vegetarian lunch included.

courses.title: Shamatha ~ Calm Abiding Retreat
courses.description: A three-day retreat with Venerable Tenzin Tsapel on developing one-pointed concentration, using the breath in the body, resting the mind and observing mental events, and awareness of awareness. Food, facility fees and materials are included; accommodation is booked separately.

courses.title: Bodhgaya Pilgrimage 2026
courses.description: A twelve-day group pilgrimage with Geshe Rabten to Bodhgaya and nearby holy places such as Nalanda, Vulture's Peak and the Vaishali stupa, staying at Root Institute, with teachings from Geshe-la on The Three Principal Aspects of the Path.

courses.title: Membership of Atisha Centre
courses.description: Friend and Supporter membership levels that fund the centre and give discounts on courses, retreats and the Dharma shop, library borrowing and AGM voting rights; Supporters also get a free night's stay each year.

courses.title: Accommodation and personal retreats
courses.description: Rooms with ensuite or shared bathrooms and powered or unpowered campsites in the bushland near the Great Stupa, for course participants, personal retreats or a quiet break. Bedding and linen are provided.
courses.price: Single occupancy with ensuite bathroom: $90.00 per person per night (shared rooms from $50.00; camping from $20.00)

free_resources.title: Wednesday Night Teachings
free_resources.description: Geshe Rabten's ongoing weekly teaching on Shantideva's Engaging in the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, translated by Venerable Lobsang Dorje, open by donation, with every session also posted as audio and video.

free_resources.title: Tuesday Night Meditation
free_resources.description: An hour of guided meditation for complete beginners on Tuesday evenings in central Bendigo, in a room beside St Paul's Cathedral, led by different presenters; by donation, with cushions and chairs provided. Not held in school holidays.

free_resources.title: Atisha Centre Publications
free_resources.description: An index of the teachings given at the centre since 2016, by Geshe Rabten and other teachers, with links to the video recordings of each course and retreat, from the Middle Length Lamrim to winter retreats.
